CandidateLedger SEALED at 1fd93dd, with a regression court and a dependency anchor. Step 1 (re-anchor the control off CandidateLedger) landed earlier at deb0fe6, so the suite no longer penalises its own repair.

The court's mutation proof exposed a far larger finding: probes name their guarded types only inside macro strings, so Zinc tracks no dependency and they never re-evaluate when that source changes. Reverting the seal incrementally left the court GREEN; under Test/clean it failed correctly. Remedy demonstrated and verified both ways. Posted at the coordination topic and recorded on bd-01M1836WDBB72KXXPKG23PSSWT.

acquire's owner may revert the seal; the measurements are the argument, not my authority.
